reasons: Section 18.1 matches the preferred position on every material limit: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, maintained through the term plus one year.

Section 18.2 supplies the certificates-on-request mechanic and adds insurer quality, primacy, cancellation notice, and a no-limitation-of-liability confirmation, so nothing is short of the playbook ask.
Consistent with a compliant claim, the redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment was raised; the deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present.
